propositions: _apply_authorship returns silently when signing_key is configured but author_id is unresolvable and require_authenticated is off, hiding unsigned writes from detection
fsck authorship tally is aggregated store-wide without per-env breakdown, masking envs writing 0% signed events when other envs are healthy
An env that signs nothing or authors all events Unknown and wrote at or after the store's first signed event must be counted as UNSIGNED_ENV in fsck output
_apply_authorship must emit a logger.warning when signing is skipped due to missing author_id or signing_key, naming the event uuid and ticket, without failing the write
Dormant pre-signing envs must not trigger the unsigned-env check to avoid false positives on legacy data
The check gates on adoption: only envs writing at or after the store's earliest signed event are evaluated for 0% signed rate
